title: Auto Clipper
subtitle: Desktop Video Tool
oneLiner: Desktop app that turns long YouTube videos into ready-to-post vertical clips automatically.
problem: Turning a long-form video into short vertical clips is tedious manual work — finding the good moments, cutting, reframing to 9:16, keeping the speaker in frame, and burning in subtitles for every single clip.
solution: Built a desktop app that does the whole pipeline: download the video, pull the transcript, let Gemini pick the interesting moments, then cut, reframe around the speaker's face, burn subtitles, and render. Go handles orchestration and state, while an embedded Python worker does everything touching media or ML.
impact: A passion project that turned a multi-hour manual edit into a few clicks. Ships as a single binary — the Python worker is embedded and extracted on first run.
highlights: Wails v2 desktop app — Go backend with a React + TypeScript frontend in one binary
Python worker (FastAPI) embedded in the binary: yt-dlp, faster-whisper, YOLOv8-face, FFmpeg
Automatic face tracking and 9:16 reframing that follows the active speaker
Gemini picks clip ranges from the transcript, scored against an engagement heatmap
Built-in overlay and cover editors, plus AES-256 encrypted settings and SQLite storage

title: Novus Next Gen
subtitle: AI Video Platform
oneLiner: Automated AI video pipeline — GPT-4 script → Gemini TTS → Seedance video → FFmpeg stitch.
problem: A content agency needed to generate dozens of branded AI videos per week. Manual editing was a bottleneck — each video took hours.
solution: Built a fully automated pipeline: input a topic, get a finished video. GPT-4 writes the script, Gemini generates voice and stills, Seedance renders the video, FFmpeg stitches audio/video, and the result is delivered via Next.js dashboard.
impact: Reduced per-video production time from ~4 hours to ~8 minutes. In a team of 2 delivered this project in 12 weeks.
highlights: Orchestrated 4 AI APIs in a single async pipeline
Built job queue with polling + webhook fallback
Docker Compose deployment on VPS with Nginx reverse proxy
Admin dashboard for batch video generation

title: Pohon Kinerja Pemda
subtitle: Performance Tree
oneLiner: Visual performance management system with hierarchical KPI trees for government employees.
problem: A regional government office tracked employee performance through scattered spreadsheets. Reporting was quarterly, manual, and impossible to audit.
solution: Built a tree-structured KPI system where managers cascade goals down to teams. Employees submit evidence, managers approve, and the system auto-calculates performance scores.
impact: Replaced 100% spreadsheet workflow. Now used by 200+ employees for monthly reporting.
highlights: Hierarchical tree data structure in PostgreSQL with closure tables
Role-based access: super admin, admin, asn lvl 1, asn lvl 2, asn lvl 3
Spring Boot + JDBC Template for raw SQL control

title: Arisan Platform
subtitle: Social Savings App
oneLiner: Digital rotating savings & credit association platform with automated payment tracking.
problem: Traditional arisan (rotating savings groups) are managed via WhatsApp and paper. Disputes over payment order and balances are common.
solution: Full platform: group creation, member management, round scheduling, payment confirmation, and a transparent ledger that all members can audit.
impact: Deployed for multiple arisan groups. Zero disputes since launch — all payment history is timestamped and immutable.
highlights: NestJS with TypeORM — clean domain model for complex savings logic
Automated round-draw algorithm with audit log
Mobile-first Next.js UI — designed for non-technical users
JWT auth with refresh token rotation

title: E-Kinerja
subtitle: Jira-like PM Tool
oneLiner: Internal project management tool with sprints and time tracking for dev teams.
problem: The engineering team had no centralized way to track tasks, sprints, or who was working on what. Context was lost in Slack threads.
solution: Built a full PM tool: projects, sprints, task lists with task assignments, comments, time logs, and a dashboard showing team velocity.
impact: Adopted by 3 teams internally. Sprint velocity improved 30% in first quarter of use.
highlights: Go Echo for high-performance API — handles concurrent task updates
Go service for report generation and scheduled summaries
Real-time task updates via Server-Sent Events
Multi-tenant: each team has isolated workspace

title: Manajemen Risiko
subtitle: Risk & Fraud Management
oneLiner: End-to-end risk & fraud management platform for local government — from goal-setting to monitoring, in one system.
problem: A regional government agency had no unified system for managing organizational risk or fraud exposure. Risk data, performance reviews, and compliance reporting lived in disconnected spreadsheets, making audits slow and fraud hard to catch early.
solution: Built a full risk management lifecycle in one platform: objective setting, risk identification, analysis, treatment, and monitoring, plus dedicated fraud risk handling, performance scoring across individual/agency/regional levels, master data management, and e-government (SPBE) reporting — backed by a Spring Boot + JPA API with session-based authentication.
impact: Consolidated a fragmented, manual risk process into a single auditable system, giving agency leadership real-time visibility into risk posture and fraud indicators instead of quarterly spreadsheet reviews.
highlights: Full risk lifecycle: objectives → identification → analysis → treatment → monitoring
Dedicated fraud risk management module for government compliance
Multi-level performance scoring — individual, agency (OPD), and regional government
Spring Boot + JPA REST API with session-based auth via X-Session-Id header
Next.js 16 App Router frontend with React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4
